summary: Recorded the clarified technical approach and risks, then handed implementation to the backend engineer.
updatedDescription:
Implement retry with exponential backoff for idempotent API calls.

## Technical approach

Keep retry policy at the API client boundary and require an idempotency key for mutating requests.

## Risks

Unbounded retries can amplify load; cap attempts and backoff duration.
acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] Retry only idempotent requests or requests carrying an idempotency key
- [ ] Cap attempts at 3
- [ ] Cover retryable and non-retryable failures in unit tests
